ex.en: The judge must remain neutral while both sides present their arguments.
ex.zh: 双方陈述观点时，法官必须保持中立。

words.note: neutr-（两者皆非）同根词：neuter、neutrality（中立）。

ex.en: They rebuilt the website from scratch after the old system failed.
ex.zh: 旧系统失效后，他们从零开始重建了网站。

words.note: from scratch 意为「从零开始」，是高频固定搭配。

ex.en: A careful analysis of the survey revealed two unexpected trends.
ex.zh: 对调查的仔细分析揭示出两个意外的趋势。

words.note: 复数是 analyses；动词 analyse/analyze，注意词形变化。

ex.en: Engineers devised a simple method to cut energy use by half.
ex.zh: 工程师想出一个简单方法，把能耗削减一半。

words.note: devise 侧重设计出方法、方案；与名词 device（装置）区分。

ex.en: The staff were cooperative and answered every question with patience.
ex.zh: 员工很配合，耐心回答了每一个问题。

words.note: co-（共同）+ operate（操作）→ 合作的；名词是 cooperation。

ex.en: Online sales tripled in three years and now exceed store sales.
ex.zh: 网上销售三年间增长两倍，现已超过门店销售。

words.note: tri-（三）；double 两倍、triple 三倍、quadruple 四倍。

ex.en: She clutched the railing tightly as the ferry began to rock.
ex.zh: 渡轮开始摇晃时，她紧紧抓住栏杆。

words.note: clutch at straws 意为「抓救命稻草」，表绝望中挣扎。

ex.en: He lost his temper when the train was delayed for the third time.
ex.zh: 火车第三次晚点时，他发火了。

words.note: lose one's temper 发火，keep one's temper 忍住不发火。

ex.en: She groped for the light switch in the dark hallway.
ex.zh: 她在漆黑的走廊里摸索着找电灯开关。

words.note: grope for 意为「摸索着找」；grope in the dark 暗中摸索。

ex.en: The whole village rejoiced when the missing child was found safe.
ex.zh: 失踪的孩子平安找到后，全村人都欢欣鼓舞。

words.note: rejoice at/over sth 为…欣喜；与 joy 同根，多用于书面。

ex.en: She made a frantic search for her passport before the flight.
ex.zh: 起飞前她发疯似地到处找护照。

words.note: be frantic with worry 表示「急得发疯」，语气很强。

ex.en: The idea of working abroad tickled his fancy for a while.
ex.zh: 出国工作的念头一度让他心动。

words.note: tickle sb's fancy 意为「使某人动心」，是常见习语。

ex.en: Several residents objected to the plan to build a factory nearby.
ex.zh: 几位居民反对在附近建厂的计划。

words.note: 作动词读 /əbˈdʒekt/；object to 中 to 是介词，后接动名词。

ex.en: He rose from a humble background to become a respected scientist.
ex.zh: 他出身卑微，后来成为受人尊敬的科学家。

words.note: in my humble opinion 是委婉表达个人意见的常用套语。

ex.en: Clean water is becoming a precious commodity in many dry regions.
ex.zh: 在许多干旱地区，清洁的水正成为珍贵之物。

words.note: com-（共同）+ mod（量度）→ 可交易之物，即商品。

ex.en: The path along the cliff was narrow, wet and dangerously slippery.
ex.zh: 沿悬崖的小路又窄又湿，滑得危险。

words.note: 复数是 cliffs；悬崖边可说 on the edge of a cliff。

ex.en: The dog was well trained and obedient to every simple command.
ex.zh: 这条狗训练有素，对每个简单口令都服从。

words.note: be obedient to sb/sth；动词 obey，名词 obedience。

ex.en: Learning a language demands infinite patience and daily practice.
ex.zh: 学一门语言需要极大的耐心和每日练习。

words.note: in-（不）+ finite（有限的）→ 无限的；finite 是其反义词。

ex.en: The long war brought misery to millions of ordinary families.
ex.zh: 漫长的战争给数百万普通家庭带来苦难。

words.note: miser-（悲惨）同根词：miserable、miserably。

ex.en: Tears blurred her vision as she read the letter.
ex.zh: 她读信时，泪水模糊了视线。

words.note: blur 可作动词也可作名词，如 a blur of colours（一片模糊）。

ex.en: A short note will suffice; there is no need for a long report.
ex.zh: 简短说明就够了，不必写长篇报告。

words.note: suffice 常与 for 连用；suffice it to say 是书面套语。

ex.en: After two hours of argument, he finally conceded that she was right.
ex.zh: 争论两小时后，他终于承认她是对的。

words.note: concede defeat 认输；concede that... 承认某事为真。

ex.en: The town is notable for its old bridge and narrow streets.
ex.zh: 这个小镇以古老的桥和狭窄的街道著称。

words.note: be notable for 意为「因…而著称」，近义词是 famous。

ex.en: His explanation sounded plausible, but the facts did not support it.
ex.zh: 他的解释听起来合理，但事实并不支持。

words.note: plaus-（鼓掌）→ 值得喝彩的，故「看似可信的」。

ex.en: The ship crossed the equator early in the morning of the fifth day.
ex.zh: 第五天清早，船越过了赤道。

words.note: equ-（相等）→ 昼夜等长之线，即赤道；同根词 equality。

ex.en: The artist received a commission to paint a portrait of the mayor.
ex.zh: 这位画家受托为市长画一幅肖像。

words.note: com-（共同）+ miss（送）→ 委托；on commission 抽取佣金。

ex.en: She hurried down the wooden staircase without turning on the light.
ex.zh: 她没开灯就匆匆下了木楼梯。

words.note: stair（楼梯）+ case（箱、容器）→ 整段楼梯。

ex.en: He flipped through the magazine while waiting for his train.
ex.zh: 等火车时，他随手翻着那本杂志。

words.note: flip through 意为「快速翻阅」；flip a coin 是掷硬币。

ex.en: It is hard to stay rational when your plans keep failing.
ex.zh: 计划一再失败时，很难保持理性。

words.note: rat-（计算、推理）同根词：rate、ratio、reason。

ex.en: Protesters built a barricade across the road and stopped the traffic.
ex.zh: 抗议者在路上筑起路障，阻断了交通。

words.note: 源自法语，指临时搭起的路障；动词义为「设障阻挡」。
